speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to help me narrow down the cause, have you noticed any numbness, weakness, or difficulty moving specific parts of your leg or foot?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L4-L5 or L5-S1).

Given your age and the sudden onset during exercise, I need to confirm if this pain follows the specific dermatomal pattern of L5 or S1, and whether you have any history of similar episodes or prior back surgeries.
